headline: Findlay reverse their home defeat by Tiffin
dek: Thursday's win was Findlay's twelfth of the season, more than any other programme has managed, and it levelled a season series Tiffin had led since October. Findlay close the calendar away to Kentucky Wesleyan today, in the only match left.
displaced_by: Today's match is at Kentucky Wesleyan; the standing dek had Findlay hosting it.
